messages:
maria: Quick check — planning a 32k-context perf sweep across H100 / A100 / L40S for decoder-only models. Need to know capacity and any known regressions this week.

kai: I can reserve a couple H100 nodes Thu/Fri morning. What model and batch?

maria: thanks. model: rdx-7b-dl, batch=1/seq streaming, repeat 3. primary metric p50/p95 token latency + memory headroom.

oliver: heads up we saw some microburst p99 spikes on L40S after the last driver update — might need the kernel fallback patch.

aya: can you paste the exact run command you want? I'll queue the A100 runs.

maria: sure — using bench harness. command: ```./bench-run --model rdx-7b-dl --skus h100,a100,l40s --ctx 32768 --batch 1 --streams 4 --repeat 3 --quant q4```

sam: pinging eng-infra — @sre-bot can we get temp elevated quota for L40S? default pool is tiny.

benchbot: queued job 17972 for h100 (node: h100-22), a100 (node: a100-07), l40s (node: l40s-04). ETA start 2026-03-26T09:10Z. Logs -> https://redwood.internal/bench/17972

jen: note: if you hit OOM on H100 at 32k, try enabling nvlink pooling + disable gradient checkpoints (we only infer so should be fine). Also confirm driver >= 525.85.

oliver: quick sanity table from earlier smoke run: ```
H100  | ~0.12 ms/token | OOM @ bs>1 without nvlink
A100  | ~0.18 ms/token | stable w/ q4
L40S  | ~0.14 ms/token | spikes p99 after 30s (kernel fallback)
```

aya: I'll start A100 now and attach perf profiles (traces + nvprof). If L40S spikes, I'll capture kernel trace and ping kernel team. :eyes:

maria: perfect. once we have raw numbers, we should decide default routing policy for 32k context requests (latency vs cost). putting notes in the bench doc. (reacted :thumbsup:)

sre-bot: quota increased for project redwood-infra by 3 L40S nodes for 4 hours.

kai: FYI I noticed a small perf regression on h100 with the thinbatch kernel in yesterday's nightly — tagging @oliver to investigate if it affects 32k paths.

maria: thanks all — I'll collate results in the console and open a short A/B rollback ticket if anything looks off. Please drop any profiling snippets in the thread.

aya: uploaded perf trace: https://redwood.internal/trace/17972/aya. I'll add flamegraphs in the doc.

oliver: I'll look at kernel/fallback logic next. if we need a quick patch, I can roll a canary with one node.

sam: noted — will hold extra capacity until end of day.

maria: closing loop later today with numbers. appreciate the quick turn.
